agreed: Owner, 20 November 2026: every sound and vibration across LynkOmni can be switched on and off, the choice is remembered and followed everywhere, and only security and safety alerts are never silenced.
rule: Every place in LynkOmni that makes a sound or vibrates has an on/off switch where the person (or, on a shared device, the manager) can reach it. A person's own choice lives once in their account (Notifications, Sounds and vibration: tap and key sounds, vibration, volume, notification sounds), is remembered, and is followed on every device and page they sign in on. A shared device follows its manager, who may let staff choose their own. Silent mode, do not disturb and quiet hours switch sounds off by themselves. Only security and safety alerts always make a sound. A sound is never the only signal: every press and alert also shows on the screen. A new sound is added here first, in the same change, with its switch.

person.remembered: Saved in the account and kept on each device, so it is followed with or without internet
